profile.summary: A for-profit education company founded in 1986 that provides reading, comprehension and math instruction. It runs learning centers and an online academy, and works with school districts and teachers through workshops. Its programs are aimed at students with dyslexia, autism spectrum disorder and other learning difficulties.
